mapper.select: SELECT TH_SENSOR_ID, TEMP_DATA, HUM_DATA, LUX_DATA, REC_TIME FROM th_sensor WHERE TO_CHAR(REC_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD') BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}

SELECT TEMP_DATA, REC_TIME FROM th_sensor WHERE REC_TIME BETWEEN STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{date}, ' ', #{startTime}), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AND STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{date}, ' ', #{endTime}), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')

SELECT HUM_DATA, REC_TIME FROM th_sensor WHERE REC_TIME BETWEEN STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{date}, ' ', #{startTime}), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AND STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{date}, ' ', #{endTime}), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')
